questions.question: Which measure of central tendency is most affected by extreme values?
questions.explanation: The mean uses every value in the dataset, so extreme values can significantly change it.

questions.question: What is the median of the dataset 2, 4, 6, 8, 10?
questions.explanation: The median is the middle value when the data is arranged in ascending order.

questions.question: If the variance of a dataset is zero, what does it indicate?
questions.explanation: Zero variance means there is no variation among the observations.

questions.question: What is the probability of getting a head when a fair coin is tossed once?
questions.explanation: A fair coin has two equally likely outcomes, so the probability of heads is 1/2.

questions.question: What is the probability of rolling a 6 on a fair six-sided die?
questions.explanation: There is one favorable outcome out of six equally likely outcomes.

questions.question: If P(A) = 0.5 and P(B|A) = 0.4, what is P(A and B)?
Which technique is commonly used to handle missing numerical values?
questions.explanation: Imputation replaces missing values using statistical or model-based methods.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)?
options: Understand patterns and relationships in data
questions.correct_answer: Understand patterns and relationships in data
questions.explanation: EDA helps analysts understand distributions, patterns, relationships and anomalies in data.

questions.question: Which chart is generally suitable for comparing values across different categories?
questions.explanation: Bar charts are commonly used to compare quantities across discrete categories.

questions.question: Which visualization is most suitable for examining the relationship between two numerical variables?
questions.explanation: A scatter plot displays paired numerical observations and helps reveal relationships or correlations.

questions.question: Which Python library is primarily used for working with tabular data?
questions.explanation: Pandas provides DataFrame and Series structures for working with structured and tabular data.

questions.question: Which Python library is commonly used for numerical array operations?
questions.explanation: NumPy provides efficient multidimensional arrays and numerical computing functions.

questions.question: What does the correlation coefficient measure?
options: Strength and direction of a linear relationship
questions.correct_answer: Strength and direction of a linear relationship
questions.explanation: Correlation describes the strength and direction of a linear association between two variables.

questions.question: Which method can be used to identify unusually distant observations in a dataset?
questions.explanation: Outlier detection identifies observations that differ substantially from the general pattern of the data.

questions.question: Which Python library is widely used for creating charts and plots?
questions.explanation: Matplotlib is a widely used Python library for creating static charts and visualizations.
